text: In Flanders a home with EPC label E or F must reach at least label D within six years of a change of ownership.
Since March 2026 the Mijn VerbouwPremie for insulation and high-efficiency glazing has stopped for owner-occupiers in income categories 1 and 2, and heat pump amounts were lowered.
Euro 5 diesel cars and vans are no longer allowed in the Brussels low-emission zone.
Buildings in a protected historic centre can face extra requirements for facade insulation and roof panels. Check the local rules before planning.
